title: Concept Bond Breaking
definition: The concept of maintaining data privacy and security by keeping all processing and storage locally, without the need for network communication.

difficulty_levels.beginner: Think of your computer as a fortress. No one can enter without your permission, and your data never leaves the fortress.
difficulty_levels.intermediate: This concept emphasizes the importance of local data processing and storage, avoiding the risks associated with network communication. It's about maintaining control over your data and keeping it secure.
difficulty_levels.expert: This concept has philosophical implications for data sovereignty and privacy. It highlights the potential benefits of decentralized systems over centralized ones, with a focus on security through isolation. This concept also connects to other fields like cryptography and distributed systems.

extra_fields.insight: The concept of maintaining data privacy and security through local processing and storage, without relying on network communication.
